title: CryptoTax Intermediate Representation
description: The contract between the Go plumbing layer and the Haskell financial core. Go normalizes all chain-specific data into this format; Haskell consumes it for cost basis and gain/loss calculations.

wallets.description: All wallet identifiers owned by the user. The Go layer uses this set to conservatively classify own-wallet transfers before the Haskell core consumes the normalized stream.

transactions.description: Chronologically sorted list of all normalized transactions across all sources.

id.description: Unique identifier. On-chain tx hash, or source-specific ID for CEX trades.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the transaction.

chain.description: The chain or platform where the transaction occurred.

tx_type.description: Classified transaction type. 'swap' = disposal of one asset + acquisition of another. 'transfer_in'/'transfer_out' = movement between own wallets (non-taxable). 'income' = airdrops, staking rewards. 'funding_payment' = Hyperliquid perp funding (ordinary income/expense). 'perp_open'/'perp_close' quarantine perpetual fills from spot FIFO.

wallet.description: The specific user wallet or account that this normalized row belongs to.

counterparty.description: The other party's address, if known. Null for CEX trades.

sent.description: What the user sent/spent. Null for buys, income, transfer_in.

received.description: What the user received. Null for sells, transfer_out.

fee.description: Transaction fee (gas, exchange fee). Adds to cost basis on buys, reduces proceeds on sells.

raw_type.description: Original transaction type from the source, for debugging. e.g. 'Uniswap V3: Exact Input', 'Market Buy'.

market.description: Optional source-backed market context when the economic row needs it. Currently used for Hyperliquid funding rows.

event_group_id.description: Stable key that ties related normalized rows back to one source event or representation group.

split_reason.description: Optional explanation for why one source event is represented as many normalized rows, such as API-fill granularity or deliberate wallet-touching leg preservation.

asset.description: Normalized display asset string. This may be a symbol like 'USDC' or a source-backed identifier like a mint when no display symbol exists.

asset_canonical.description: Optional canonical identity when it differs from the display asset, such as a Solana mint alongside display symbol 'USDC'.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount as a string. NEVER a float. e.g. '1.234567890123456789'.

usd_value.description: Fair market value in USD at the time of the transaction, as a string. e.g. '3456.78'. Resolved by Go via CoinGecko or source-provided price.
